rationale: Incomplete responses suggest excessive computation, but do not prove it. This repair retains geometry filtering and arc consistency, caches domain summaries and BFS results, and branches on a necessary condition: every observed path below minimum_steps must be blocked. Fine-grid access checks run lazily. Search has explicit work and memory bounds; a checked complete fallback is sought first. Bounded search can still miss a feasible layout, and access screening remains an approximation of the unavailable verifier. No tests or validation gains are claimed.
